title: Orthodontic Benefit Riders Training Note — Part-Period Share of the First Takeover Installment
content:
**Orthodontic Benefit Riders: first takeover installment and the date coverage began.** For the member's repayment, the first takeover installment covers only the part of its service period that falls after coverage began.

| Schedule | Month of that service period in which coverage began | Share of the first takeover installment |
|---|---|---|
| quarterly | second month of the quarter | two thirds |
| quarterly | third month of the quarter | one third |
| quarterly | first month of the quarter | all of it |
| monthly | any | all of it |

When coverage began before the first service period of the original schedule, the first takeover installment covers that first period in full.

| Rider | Schedule | Service periods start, in months after the banding month |
|---|---|---|
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 1000 | quarterly | 3, then every 3 months |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 1500 | quarterly | 3, then every 3 months |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 1500 | quarterly | 3, then every 3 months |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 2000 | monthly | 1, then every month |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 2000 | monthly | 1, then every month |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 3000 | monthly | 1, then every month |

*Hypothetical cases on a quarterly rider* (quarters starting in the 3rd, 6th and 9th months after the banding month):

| Coverage began in | Quarter | Share |
|---|---|---|
| the 7th month | the quarter of months 6 to 8, second month | two thirds |
| the 8th month | the same quarter, third month | one third |
| the 6th month | that quarter's first month | all of it |
| the 2nd month | before the first quarter | all of it |
